title: Senior Oracle Database Administrator
full_description:
At ING we are looking for an Oracle Database Administrator
Your role and work environment:
We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Oracle Database Administrator to join our Platform Automation area within Cloud and Tech Foundations Tribe to provide the organization with an automated foundational layer for present and future Tech Platform
Your key responsibilities:
What you'll be doing as an Oracle Database Administrator:
Ensure automation/removal of manual intervention in all processes related to the IT Assets.
Secure the operational performance of the IT Assets which are delivered and maintained.
Ensure monitoring of infrastructure and development of predictive alert systems to prevent incidents.
Continuously take the initiative to improve the way of work and the collaboration on the squad.
Responsibility for developing, managing, harmonising and phasing out Oracle products and services.
Accountable for maximizing the product's value resulting from squad's work; you support and develop your colleagues through effective knowledge sharing and resource usage and promote the one agile way of working (OAWoW) culture.
Communicate technical issues to a non-technical audience.
What are we looking for?
We work in an Agile & DevOps environment, where Scrum & Kanban are part of our One Agile Way of Working. You would be part of a Scrum Team, working on two-weeks sprints and using Azure as a key-tool for our Software Development Life Cycle and keeping our IT Risk under control.
Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!
We’re currently looking for someone who:
Good understanding of the Oracle/SQLServer database, related utilities and tools
Installation, configuration and upgrading of database software and related products.
Establish and maintain backup and recovery policies (RMAN-Datapump)
Perform database tuning and performance.
Maintenance and optimization of databases and queries.
Incident resolution and system operation.
Plan growth and changes (capacity planning)
Patch Management (applying patchset and PSU)
Storage knowledge (ASM infrastructure – griddisk - diskgroup)
Replication processGoldengateData Guard (Active) – switchover and failover process.Always On – switchover and failover process.
Data Guard (Active) – switchover and failover process.
Always On – switchover and failover process.
Ability to perform both database and operating system (Linux/Windows) performance tuning.
Monitoring (Prometheus-Grafana)
Has experience in backlog management.
Has experience in planning and managing the Life Cycle of applications in production.
Has knowledge of software development lifecycle tools such as Azure DevOps and Ansible.
Can collaborate with SREs to identify root-cause and remediate any issues in production.
Can work in an autonomous way and take initiative.
Makes things happen thanks to his/her ‘can do’ attitude.
Takes the initiative for improving processes, ensuring creative ideas are implemented.
Is a leader of our Orange Code culture, displaying a positive attitude, commitment towards our goals, accountability, eagerness to learn and not afraid of change.
Public and private cloud experience
The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.
Check out what is waiting for you!
Be flexible my friend.
Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues’ needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing.
So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.
Our house will be your home.
In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!
For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).
We help you protect what matters most to you.
Flexible remuneration.
In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…
